items.headline: A documentary on fashion's Antwerp Six
items.caption: A film and book tell the story of Belgium's legendary designers.
body: The Six include Ann Demeulemeester, Dries Van Noten and Walter Van Beirendonck.
They graduated from Antwerp's Royal Academy in the '80s and put the city on the fashion map.
Style lesson: dark, layered, unexpected.

items.headline: Ferragamo's Hollywood comeback with Criterion
items.caption: The shoemaker who started in silent films returns to cinema.
body: Salvatore Ferragamo began making shoes for films before becoming a luxury label.
A Criterion collaboration taps that Hollywood history.
How to wear it: classic loafers, cropped trousers, film-star posture.

items.headline: Nike puts the Air Max 90 in a puffer jacket
items.caption: Padded leather in 'Medium Olive'.
body: The uppers are stitched like a puffer coat.
An all-black version is also coming.
How to wear it: with a matching olive jacket for full puffer energy.

items.headline: Wales Bonner is making athleisure grown-up
items.caption: Comfortable clothes that are smart enough nobody questions it.
body: Collaborations like adidas × Wales Bonner show where athleisure is heading.
Outerwear is the standout.
How to wear it: a track jacket over tailored trousers.

items.headline: The £70 adidas Antonelli wore to win the F1 title
items.caption: A very normal pair of Handball Spezials.
body: Antonelli walked the paddock in Handball Spezials with his 11-year-old sister.
No rare collab, just a classic everyday sneaker.
How to wear it: with straight jeans and a team jacket.

items.headline: Nike's Lahar Low is back to take on Paraboot
items.caption: A hiking classic returns after five years.
body: It traces back to the 1989 Lahar Escape boot.
Hiking style is everywhere, from Vomeros to Jordans.
How to wear it: grey flannels and a chunky knit.

items.headline: Noughties Tom Hardy is your 2026 suit inspiration
items.caption: Printed tees and flyaway collars under tailoring.
body: Young Hardy wore suits loosely, like today's best-dressed guys.
Esquire shows how to do it 20 years on.
How to wear it: a relaxed suit with a graphic tee.

items.headline: Skyler Gisondo dresses like '90s Harrison Ford
items.caption: The 'Primetime' and 'Superman' actor fronts a new Bonobos campaign.
body: Gisondo plays Jimmy Olsen in Superman.
He's channelling '90s Harrison Ford for his look.
How to wear it: a chore coat, khakis and a crisp tee.

items.headline: Inside Ralph Lauren's first PoloFest in Tokyo
items.caption: 50 years of Ralph Lauren in Japan, celebrated with vintage.
body: The three-day event was part museum, part vintage market.
Fans came from around the world.
How to wear it: a vintage Polo cable knit over a button-down.

items.headline: A. Lange & Söhne's history show in New York
items.caption: Watches from across the German maker's history, marking 32 years since its revival.
body: The exhibition celebrated the brand's 1994 re-founding.
It traced how its designs evolved.
Style lesson: one great watch outlasts every trend.

items.headline: A festival celebrates the right whales' return
items.caption: Florida's Amelia Island welcomes one of the largest whale species back south.
body: The Right Whale Festival has run every year since 2009.
It marks the whales' migration to subtropical breeding grounds.
It's on at Fernandina Beach's Main Beach Park.

items.headline: Rescued from a burning car, a family now funds hero scholarships
items.caption: Strangers saved Kenli Riney; her mom now rewards people like them.
body: Five years ago, Mike Argote and three men pulled 18-year-old Kenli from a burning car in Texas.
Mike, burned himself, started CPR; his 14-year-old daughter Ema took over.
Kenli's mother now funds scholarships for everyday heroes.

items.headline: A weather app made just for dogs
items.caption: Pawcast forecasts conditions at paw and head height.
body: It reports temperatures for asphalt, grass and concrete.
Forecasts adjust for breed, size and coat length.
It helps owners plan safer walks.
